name: tldraw-local
description: Local clean-room replica of the tldraw Codex plugin. Boards are .tldr files on this machine.

interface.longDescription: Local replica of the tldraw Codex plugin. You and your agent draw on an infinite canvas stored as .tldr files on this computer. It is not the official tldraw.com plugin and does not sign in to tldraw.com.
